literal: among rare things / all / rare indeed / great people / having cherished / as one's own / securing
translation: Among all rare things, the rarest is to cherish great people and secure them as one's own.
modern: கிடைப்பதற்கு அரிய பேறுகள் எல்லாவற்றிலும் மிகவும் அரியது, பெரியவர்களைப் போற்றி அவர்களைத் தமது சுற்றத்தாராக ஆக்கிக் கொள்வதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the supreme value of associating with great and wise people. The phrase 'அரியவற்றுள் எல்லாம் அரிதே' highlights that among all the rare and precious things one could acquire in life, this is the most valuable. By using 'பேணித் தமராக் கொளல்', the poet advises not just to respect great people from a distance, but to actively cherish them and make them one's own close allies. This close bond with the wise provides unparalleled guidance and strength.
